# AdsPower — Secure Antidetect Browser for Multi-Account Management

> Founded in 2019, AdsPower is a secure antidetect browser that helps businesses manage multiple online accounts safely and efficiently. Trusted by over 10 million users worldwide and certified to SOC 2 Type II standards, AdsPower provides isolated browser profiles, customizable browser fingerprints, proxy management, automation, and collaboration tools for affiliate marketing, e-commerce, social media, SEO, web scraping, and digital advertising.

## Core Features

- [Antidetect Browser](https://www.adspower.com/antidetect-browser)：Create isolated browser profiles with unique browser fingerprints - Includes: User-Agent, Cookies, Canvas, WebGL, WebRTC, Timezone, Language, Screen Resolution, Fonts, Local Storage, and other fingerprint parameters - Best For: Managing multiple Facebook, TikTok, Amazon, eBay, Reddit, or X accounts with isolated browser identities to reduce account association risks.
- [Multi-Account Management](https://www.adspower.com/multi-account-management)：Create, organize, and manage browser profiles at scale - Supports: Batch operations, profile grouping, cookie management, synchronization, import & export, and team collaboration - Best For: Agencies, e-commerce sellers, affiliate marketers, and social media teams managing hundreds of browser profiles.
- [Multi-Window Synchronizer](https://www.adspower.com/synchronizer)：Synchronize browser actions across multiple browser windows - Best For: Posting on multiple TikTok accounts, managing Facebook Pages, operating multiple marketplace stores, or performing repetitive browser tasks simultaneously.
- [RPA Automation](https://www.adspower.com/rpa)：No-code browser automation platform - Supports: Workflow recording, scheduled execution, batch automation, reusable templates - Best For: Automating account login, data collection, social media actions, form submission, browser testing, and repetitive business workflows.
- [Local API](https://www.adspower.com/local-api)：Control browser profiles programmatically - Compatible With: Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright, and custom automation frameworks - Best For: Developers building browser automation, web scraping systems, AI agents, and large-scale multi-account management tools.

## Solutions

- [Affiliate Marketing](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/affiliate-marketing)：Best For: Managing multiple Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads, CPA, and affiliate marketing accounts with isolated browser profiles.
- [E-Commerce](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/e-commerce)：Best For: Running multiple Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, eBay, Etsy, Walmart Marketplace, and other cross-border e-commerce stores securely.
- [Digital Agency](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/digital-agency)：Best For: Marketing agencies managing client accounts across Google, Meta, TikTok, Shopify, Amazon, and other platforms with secure team collaboration.
- [Social Marketing](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/social-marketing)：Best For: Managing multiple TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Discord accounts without browser fingerprint conflicts.
- [Web Scraping](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/web-scraping)：Best For: Browser-based web scraping, data collection, price monitoring, competitor research, lead generation, and automated browsing.
- [Traffic Arbitrage](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/traffic-arbitrage)：Best For: Operating Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads, native advertising, and media buying accounts while reducing account association risks.
- [SEO & SERP Monitoring](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/seo-serp)：Best For: Monitoring Google Search results across multiple countries, tracking keyword rankings, performing localized SERP testing, and analyzing competitors.
- [Ticketing](https://www.adspower.com/solutions/ticketing)：Best For: Managing multiple Ticketmaster, AXS, Live Nation, and other ticketing platform accounts with isolated browser environments.

## Supported Platforms

- **E-Commerce & Marketplaces**: Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Etsy, Walmart Marketplace.
- **Social Media & Networks**: TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, Telegram, Google.

## Resources & Links

- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.adspower.com/pricing)：Plans: Free, Professional, Business, Enterprise, and Custom. - Billing: Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual plans. - Includes: Browser profile limits, team collaboration, automation features, Local API access, and enterprise capabilities.

An antidetect browser (also called anti fingerprint browser) is an anonymous browser designed to minimize the ability of websites and tracking systems to identify and track your digital fingerprint. These undetected browsers employ various techniques to mask or alter browser fingerprints. After fingerprint spoofing, you can act like a real person to make it difficult for websites or online platforms to identify and keep your multiple accounts secure.

AdsPower antidetect browser allows you to create multiple profiles with unique browser fingerprints based on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. Taking it a notch higher, each profile is fully customizable, allowing you to adjust its IP, language, resolution, timezone, cookies, geolocation, fonts, proxy, DNS, Canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, IndexedDB, etc. This helps keep accounts and browsing environments separate and reduces the risk of websites associating different accounts with the same browser environment.


AdsPower works with all popular proxy protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, Socks5, SSH) and IPv4/IPv6 addresses. We don't offer built-in proxies, but seamlessly integrate with a wide range of providers like Bright Data, Oxylabs, and more. You can also test your proxy connection in AdsPower before using it with a profile.


AdsPower combines advanced fingerprint management, anti-tracking capabilities, and powerful automation tools. Its browser fingerprints are highly customizable and managed at the browser kernel level, while features like Local API and RPA make multi-account management and automation easier. With broad proxy compatibility and strong data protection, AdsPower offers a flexible and secure antidetect browser solution. For a closer comparison, see how AdsPower ranks among the best antidetect browsers in 2026.


We offer a free trial of AdsPower, which allows you to create up to 2 profiles. It's a simple way to test browser fingerprint management and multi-account workflows before upgrading to a paid plan.
